scope: Men's full internationals; source also contains some non-FIFA representative teams

method.name: chronological Elo research baseline
method.note: Ratings are strength priors only, not calibrated 1X2 probabilities

team_registry.note: FIFA lists 211 affiliated member associations. Names are stored as published by FIFA; aliases map historical-results source labels to those names. Membership is not proof that every historical row is a senior men's A-international.
team_registry.forecast_policy: Research classification only. No team is forecast-eligible until competition scope, team identity, senior men's status, source consistency, and out-of-sample validation are separately approved.

readiness_note: Do not publish predictions until a separate chronological out-of-sample model and calibration review is completed.

backtest.method: date-grouped chronological 80/20 Elo holdout with training-only draw calibration
backtest.note: Holdout probabilities use only prior-date Elo ratings and draw-rate bins learned from earlier training dates. All fixtures on the same date share the same pre-date ratings. Research diagnostic only; not a production forecast.
